title: Dutch Dynamics Community Event 10 February 2026
summary: A Dutch Dynamics Community event on February 10, 2026 featured technical sessions on creating AI agents inside Business Central (released in version 27.4) and using Copilot for AI pair programming in AL development. The post emphasizes how agents work within the existing Business Central environment and the importance of effective prompts for better AI assistance.
key_points: Creating AI agents in Business Central version 27.4 allows developers to build agents that navigate existing pages and follow user workflows naturally
AI agents can expose extension functionality to users similar to how regular users interact with features
Effective prompts and instruction files significantly improve AI code assistance and make Copilot a better intellectual sparring partner
In-person community events provide irreplaceable value for discussing AI tools and sharing practical experiences beyond online content

quotes.text: Creating your own AI agents inside Business Central was just released in version 27.4 of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the availability and version number of a major new AI feature

quotes.text: Your goal is to be an intellectual sparring partner, not just an agreeable assistant.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the importance of crafting prompts that challenge and improve thinking rather than simply confirming existing ideas
